parts.text:
## Project summary

This workspace is a **Bun-powered React 19 todo application** styled with **Tailwind CSS 4 and custom CSS**.

### Main functionality

The app allows users to:

- Add tasks
- Mark tasks as complete or incomplete
- Edit task titles
- Delete tasks
- View the number of remaining tasks
- Persist tasks in browser `localStorage`

Todo IDs are generated with `crypto.randomUUID()`. Stored data is validated before being loaded to avoid using malformed entries.

### Architecture

- **`src/App.tsx`** — Main todo UI and state-management logic
- **`src/frontend.tsx`** — Mounts the React application
- **`src/index.ts`** — Bun server entry point
- **`src/index.html`** — HTML application shell
- **`src/index.css`** — Tailwind import and extensive responsive custom styling
- **`src/APITester.tsx`** — Auxiliary API-testing component
- **`build.ts`** — Production build script
- **`dist/`** — Generated production assets
- **`test.js`** — Auxiliary test script

### Technology stack

- Bun
- React 19
- React DOM 19
- Tailwind CSS 4
- `bun-plugin-tailwind`
- TypeScript in the existing source
- Browser `localStorage` for persistence

### Commands

```bash
bun install   # Install dependencies
bun dev       # Run the development server with hot reload
bun start     # Run in production mode
bun run build # Create the production build
```

Overall, it is a polished, responsive, client-side task manager built from a Bun React template. It currently has no database or external backend persistence; todos remain local to the user's browser.

/**
 * This file is the entry point for the React app, it sets up the root
 * element and renders the App component to the DOM.
 *
 * It is included in `src/index.html`.
 */

import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import { App } from "./App";

function start() {
  const root = createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!);
  root.render(<App />);
}

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", start);
} else {
  start();
}

              ## Project summary

This workspace is a **Bun-powered React 19 todo application** styled with **Tailwind CSS 4 and custom CSS**.

### Main functionality

The app allows users to:

- Add tasks
- Mark tasks as complete or incomplete
- Edit task titles
- Delete tasks
- View the number of remaining tasks
- Persist tasks in browser `localStorage`

Todo IDs are generated with `crypto.randomUUID()`. Stored data is validated before being loaded to avoid using malformed entries.

### Architecture

- **`src/App.tsx`** — Main todo UI and state-management logic
- **`src/frontend.tsx`** — Mounts the React application
- **`src/index.ts`** — Bun server entry point
- **`src/index.html`** — HTML application shell
- **`src/index.css`** — Tailwind import and extensive responsive custom styling
- **`src/APITester.tsx`** — Auxiliary API-testing component
- **`build.ts`** — Production build script
- **`dist/`** — Generated production assets
- **`test.js`** — Auxiliary test script

### Technology stack

- Bun
- React 19
- React DOM 19
- Tailwind CSS 4
- `bun-plugin-tailwind`
- TypeScript in the existing source
- Browser `localStorage` for persistence

### Commands

```bash
bun install   # Install dependencies
bun dev       # Run the development server with hot reload
bun start     # Run in production mode
bun run build # Create the production build
```

Overall, it is a polished, responsive, client-side task manager built from a Bun React template. It currently has no database or external backend persistence; todos remain local to the user's browser.
